1.title: Do D.E.I. Bike Paths Exist? The Trump Administration Says Yes.
1.summary: The administration has revoked funding for bike paths, and encouraged removing some. A cycling advocate said it is playing on the idea of “that dork on a bike.”

2.title: Company offering reward for safe return of truckload of beer
2.summary: Police say a thief presented false documentation at a California distribution centre before driving off with the shipment.

3.title: Death Toll Rises in Grand Canyon Flood as Search Efforts Continue
3.summary: Officials announced a second death and said more than a dozen people remain unaccounted for following heavy rain.

4.title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
4.summary: The singer, 21, will be now represented by a public defender in the murder trial of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. He has pleaded not guilty.

5.title: Ukrainian Drone Mastermind, Fired by Kyiv, Will Advise Italy’s Defense Chief
5.summary: The appointment of Mykhailo Fedorov, a Ukrainian former defense minister, showed how other militaries are racing to adapt to battlefield changes accelerated by the war in Ukraine.

6.title: Spanish Leader Says 5,000 Migrants Are Still in Ceuta, Weeks After Border Surge
6.summary: Their continued presence has roiled the Spanish territory in Africa and heaped pressure on Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.
